description: Always rounds up to the NEXT multiple, so exact multiples are increased by a full step.
report_specific: round_up_minutes(15) returns 30 instead of 15, and round_up_minutes(0) returns 15 instead of 0. Values that are already a multiple of the step should not change.
report_vague: Invoices charge an extra 15 minutes whenever the logged time was already a round number.
